integrity: Unrestricted graph-fold and relative-chain proof; finite independent mod-two and graph adjacency checks included; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The conclusion is integral homology only, for n>=4 and one removed rim edge; acyclicity does not establish contractibility, and no multiple-fault or equivariant classification is claimed.
title: Integral homology of Möbius ladders after one rim-edge deletion
